# Projects

Stars are as displayed on GitHub on 2026-10-21 (PT); license and last commit come from a shallow clone the same day. **Evidence** is the highest rung of the [evidence ladder](../02-evidence-ladder.md) that a third party can inspect for the project's headline performance claim (`bench` = it evaluates other systems; `n/a` = infrastructure or no performance claim). **Repro** says whether the headline numbers can be regenerated from the repo.
